plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Deputy Director - Operation : 1
• Deputy Director - Program : 1

• Block Program Manager : 264
• Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator (Block) : 264
• Deputy Director - Operation : Postgraduate degree in Horticulture/Agriculture or MBA in Agriculture Marketing/Agribusiness (10 years of relevant experience)
• Deputy Director - Program : Postgraduate degree in Horticulture/Agriculture or MBA in Agriculture Marketing/Agribusiness (10 years of relevant experience)
• State Program Manager : Postgraduate degree in Horticulture/Agriculture or two-year MBA in Agriculture Marketing/Agribusiness (10 years of relevant experience, including district-level experience)
• State Technical Horticulture Officer : Graduate degree in Horticulture or Agriculture (3 years of relevant experience)
• State MIS Officer : MCA, M.Sc (IT) or B.Tech (CSE) (5 years of experience in a similar role)
• Documentation-cum-Knowledge Management Officer : Postgraduate degree in Journalism or Mass Communication (4 years of relevant experience)
• Accountant : Full-time graduate degree in Commerce, Finance or Accounting with first class/division (3 years of relevant experience)
• Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator : Full-time graduation with ADCA or BCA/B.Sc (IT) (2 years of experience in a similar role or office environment)
• District Program Manager : Full-time postgraduate degree or higher in Horticulture/Agriculture (5 years of relevant experience with prior block-level experience)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Selection / Interview Date WILL ANNOUNCE
• The selection process comprises a written test (if applicant numbers exceed 15 times the vacancy count) followed by a personal interview.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Young Professional II : 11 (Minimum 21 years – Maximum 45 years)
• Young Professional I : 06 (Minimum 21 years – Maximum 45 years)
• Total : 35

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Interview Time 11:00 AM; candidates are requested to be present one hour before for document verification
• All eligible candidates are requested to be at the venue one hour before the scheduled 11:00 AM start for document verification. Selection is through interview, in this order
• Screening test: if a large number of candidates turn up, a screening test of multiple-choice objective questions may be held to shortlist candidates for the interview.
• Interview: the shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by the Selection Committee. Candidates have the option to interact in Hindi or English before the committee.
• If many candidates turn up, interviews may continue till late in the evening or into the next day, so candidates are requested to plan their travel accordingly.
• Only candidates who strictly fulfil the eligibility criteria and possess the degree/mark sheet in the stated subjects should turn up for the walk-in interview.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written screening test (Computer Based Test or OMR based test)
• Document verification
• Written screening test by CBT; OMR based test may be preferred where the number of candidates is limited.
• Candidates shortlisted for document verification to allow recommendation and the waiting panel.
• Option for Departments/Districts in order of preference given in writing at document verification, where applicable; allocation on Merit-cum-Option-cum-Availability of Post.
• Multiple-shift CBT scores normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method).

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• Sr. Consultant (BCC) : 1 (Rs. 42,000/month)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Selection is based on qualification, experience and performance in the interview. Incomplete applications are not considered for short listing.
• The posts are for immediate requirement, and the Society may prioritize interviews for different categories of posts based on its needs.
• Originals of documents may be required at the interview.
• Candidates on deputation posts are expected to apply through proper channel. If that is not possible in time, they must produce a no-objection certificate from the employer at the interview.
• No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (RAILWAY) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Assistant Teacher (UP TGT) : Candidates must have a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks, or a qualifying postgraduate degree under the stated conditions, along with a B.Ed. degree from an NCTE-recognized programme. Candidates must also have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) upper-primary level (Classes 6–8) conducted by the State Government or Government of India.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Written Exam Interview (Viva-Voce) Document Verification
• Written Exam
• Interview (Viva-Voce)
• Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===

• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Bihar BSSC Field Assistant : 201 (Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) or hold a Diploma in Agriculture from a recognized institute or university. Note: Equivalent qualifications or other academic degrees will not be accepted for this post.)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Mains Form Date : 22 – 31 October 2026
• How To Fill Bihar BSSC Field Assistant Mains Online Form 2026

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

Applicants must also fulfill the required age criteria and must be citizens of India to be considered eligible.
• Master of Design (M. Des.) : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from a recognized university , or they must possess a 3-year Diploma from NIFT or NID . Applicants should also meet the prescribed age limit and must be citizens of India to qualify for the application process.
• Master of Fashion Management (M.F.M.) : Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream from a recognized university , or a 3-year Diploma from NIFT or NID to be eligible. Along with the educational qualification, applicants must also fulfill the required age criteria and be Indian citizens as per official guidelines.
• Master of Fashion Technology (M.F.Tech.) : Candidates must have completed B.F.Tech from NIFT or hold a B.E./B.Tech degree from a recognized university or institution . Applicants must also satisfy the age requirements and be citizens of India as per official rules.
• Bachelor of Design (B.Des.) For Artisan Category : Candidates must have passed Class 12th from a recognized board , including NIOS , or possess a 3–4 year Diploma or an equivalent qualification . Additionally, applicants must have a valid Artisan Card . Along with the educational criteria, candidates must also fulfill the prescribed age limit and be citizens of India as per official guidelines.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)

• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SBI  2026 Notification: Registration Deadline Extended : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• AIIMS Faculty  2026 Out for 260 Posts, Eligibility, Salary, Selection Process : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (260 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Objective Examination (Child Pedagogy, Languages & Subject Concerned)
• Stage 2: Document Verification / Demo Teaching / Academic Merit List

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | Combined
• 2. Language-I & Language-II | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | 150 Minutes
• 3. Domain Subject (Maths/Science/Social/TGT/PGT) | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | (2.5 Hours)
• Total | 150 Qs | 150 Marks | 150 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Multiple Choice Questions (OMR / CBT)
• Focus Area: NEP 2020, NCF, Inclusive Education, Pedagogy & Subject Mastery

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Child Development & Pedagogy: Theories of Piaget, Vygotsky & Kohlberg, Concept of Inclusive Education & Special Needs, NEP 2020, RTE Act 2009 & NCF Guidelines, Assessment, Evaluation & Learning Motivation
• 2. Language-I & II (Hindi/English): Unseen Prose & Poetry Comprehension, Principles of Language Teaching & Acquisition, Grammar, Vocabulary, Figures of Speech & Remedial Teaching
• 3. Concerned Subject & GS: NCERT/SCERT Core Subject Syllabus (Class 6 to 12 Level), Indian National Movement, Polity, Geography & Environment, Basic Arithmetic, Reasoning & Current Affairs

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TEACHING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Kolkata Police Constable Final Exam Date 2026 Out: Check Examination Scheme : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• Storekeeper cum Accountant (Child Care Institution) : 1 (Rs.18,536/- with 3% annual increment)

• House Mother (Child Care Institution) : 1 (Rs.14,564/- with 3% annual increment)
• House Father (Child Care Institution) : 3 (Rs.14,564/- with 3% annual increment)
• Nurse (Child Care Institution) : 23 (Rs. 13,240/- with 3% annual increment)

• Educator (Child Care Institution) : 2 (Rs. 10,000/- with 3% annual increment)
• Art & Craft cum Music Teacher (Child Care Institution) : 2 (Rs. 10,000/- with 3% annual increment)
• Cook (Child Care Institution) : 5 (Rs.9,930/- with 3% annual increment)
• Care Taker cum Vocational Instructor (Child Care Institution) : 23 (Rs.9,930/- with 3% annual increment)
• Helper cum Night Watchman (Child Care Institution) : 4 (Rs.7,944/- with 3% annual increment)
• Housekeeper (Child Care Institution) : 3 (Rs.7,944/- with 3% annual increment)
• Art & Craft cum Music Teacher : Aizawl - 1 (Female only), Mamit - 1
• Project Coordinator : Post Graduate Degree in Social Work/ Sociology/ Child Development/ Clinical Psychology/ Psychology/ Human Right/Education/ Human Development & Family Studies from a recognized University acquiring at least 55 %. Proficiency in computer acquiring CCC/ DCA 1st Sem. (21 - 40 years)
• Case Worker (Child Care Institution) : Post Graduate Degree in the same subjects as Project Coordinator from a recognized University acquiring at least 55 %. Proficiency in computer acquiring CCC/ DCA 1st Sem. (18 to 35 years)
• Special Educator/ Therapist : M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology/ Rehabilitation Psychology, OR Bachelors' degree in Occupational Therapy/ Physio Therapy/ Speech Therapy, OR Diploma in Special Education (IDD/MD/VI/HI) or above. Each option needs a valid RCI CRR number. Proficiency in computer acquiring CCC/ DCA 1st Sem. (18 to 35 years)
• Data Analyst : Bachelor's Degree in Statistics/ Mathematics/ Economics from a recognized University acquiring at least 55 % with 'O' Level in Computer, OR Bachelor in Computer Application. (18 to 35 years)
• Storekeeper cum Accountant : Graduate in Commerce/ Mathematics degree from a recognized university acquiring at least 55 %. Command on Tally. Proficiency in computer acquiring CCC/ DCA 1st Sem. (18 to 35 years)
• Case Worker (Child Helpline Unit) : Bachelor's degree in Social Work/ Sociology/ Child Development/ Clinical Psychology/ Psychology/ Human Right/Education/ Human Development & Family Studies from a recognized University acquiring at least 55 %. Proficiency in computer acquiring CCC/ DCA 1st Sem. (18 to 35 years)
• Educator, Art & Craft cum Music Teacher : Class XII passed from a recognized Board. (18 to 35 years)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Interview will be conducted for all posts. Candidates shortlisted for interview will be notified at wcd.mizoram.gov.in , and the date of interview will be notified later on the same website.
• Application form and interview updates Women & Child Development website, Mizoram

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Interview 60% 50%
• Interview 40% (Technical & Professional proficiency 30; Personality Communication & Competency 10)
• No minimum qualifying marks are required in the aggregate. The interview may be taken in Hindi or English.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Quantitative Aptitude | Around 35 | Number system, arithmetic, geometry, algebra, series, trigonometry, quadratic equations, mensuration, average, profit and loss, ratio and proportion, work and time, time and distance, probability, interest, permutation and combination
• Data Interpretation | Around 35 | Data in tables, charts and graphs, series
• Logical Reasoning | Around 35 | Puzzles, seating arrangements, inequalities, venn diagrams, blood relations, directions, orders and ranking, verbal reasoning, spatial abilities, pattern recognition

• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning

• Post Code : ND0401

• Total : 215
• Reservation Type : No. of Posts

• Experience : 2 Years as Junior Assistant or in an Equivalent Post
• Total Marks : 200
• Marks per Correct Answer : 2
• Total Marks : 100
• Minimum Qualifying Marks : 50

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Selection Process Preliminary Test, Main Examination and Qualifying Skill Test
• Skill Test Date WILL ANNOUNCE
• Skill Test - Computer proficiency, office procedures, noting, drafting and typing.
• Document Verification - Verification of qualification, experience and other eligibility claims.
• The Skill Test carries 100 marks and is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 50 marks to qualify.
• The Skill Test covers the Manual of Office Procedures, noting and drafting, computer operations and typing proficiency.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• General Studies | 20
• Reasoning | 20
• General Mathematical Ability | 20
• Administration of Higher Educational Institutions | 40
• Total | 100
• Educational Administration and Management; Functional Aspects of Rules and Their Application in Higher Educational Institutions | 200
• Total | 200
• The Preliminary Test consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks , with a duration of two hours and 30 minutes.
• Total Marks 200
• Duration 2 Hours 30 Minutes
• Negative Marking 0.5 Mark per Wrong Answer
• The Main Examination is descriptive in nature and carries 200 marks, with a duration of two hours.
• Total Marks 100

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• KPSC recruitment cases: Karnataka proposes 4 police officers to lead revamped SIT : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.

• WBSSC Group C And D Notification Out For 8478 Posts, Edit Option Notice For OBC Category : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (8478 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (SSC) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (RAILWAY) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• UPSC Announces CDS 1 2026 Final Merit List, 243 Candidates Recommended for IMA, INA and AFA : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)
• 4. General Hindi / English Language | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Written Exam) | 150 Qs | 300 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics

• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR / Computer Based Test)
• Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST — Height/Chest) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET — Running)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Detailed Medical Examination (DME)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes

• Exam Mode: Objective Type Written Exam followed by Physical Endurance Test
• Negative Marking: 0.25 / 0.50 Marks deducted per wrong answer as per board rule
• Physical Requirement: Qualifying in PST & Running (PET) is mandatory

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===

• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• BPSC TRE 4.0: Registration date extended for 33320 posts, apply at bpsc.bih.nic.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (33320 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. • 4. === 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Knowledge & Current Affairs | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | Combined
• 2. Numerical & Mental Ability | 38 Qs | 76 Marks | 120 Minutes
• 3. Mental Aptitude, IQ & Reasoning | 37 Qs | 74 Marks | (2 Hours)

• Duration 3 Hours
• The official GSSSB notice confirms negative marking in the MCQ-CBRT examination.

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. General Knowledge & State GK: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights & Police Act, History, Culture, Geography & Economy of India, State-Specific GK (Districts, Folk Arts, Rivers, Schemes), Internal Security, Human Rights & Cyber Crime, National & International Current Affairs & Awards
• 2. Reasoning & Mental Aptitude: Number/Letter Series, Coding-Decoding & Analogy, Direction Sense, Blood Relations & Ranking, Syllogism, Logical Venn Diagrams & Dice, Public Interest, Law & Order, Communal Harmony, Rule of Law, Professional Information & Police System
• 3. Numerical Ability (Maths): Number System, Simplification, HCF & LCM, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Partnership, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Mensuration
• 4. Language (Hindi / English): Varnmala, Sandhi, Samas & Upsarg-Pratyay, Tatsam-Tadbhav, Paryayvachi & Vilom Shabd, Muhavare, Lokoktiyan & Vakyansh ke liye ek shabd, Kaal, Vachya, Avyay & Ashuddhi Shodhan, Unseen Passage Comprehension & Famous Poets/Authors

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• SSC JE Exam 2026: Check CBT 1 Exam Day Guidelines, Shift Timings & Reporting Time Here : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined

• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. • 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix

• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Programmes : Eligible UG, PG, Diploma and Certificate Programmes

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Online / Written Computer Based Test (Domain Technical + Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Trade Test / Skill & Practical Test (Qualifying in Nature)
• Stage 3: Document Verification & Pre-Employment Medical Examination

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes

• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• SSC JE 2026 Exam Date Out for 1748 Vacancies (Revised), Exam Pattern & Selection Process : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (1748 Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• SSC CGL Admit Card 2026 Out For 28 October, Download Link @ssc.gov.in : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Dest)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.
